lastCompletedStory.title: Reduce cam-plan.md to a thin phase-signal stub; regen embed; ADR + close refactor

nextStoryContext: US-005 closed the CAM-151 phase-refactor cycle. Key changes: (1) .claude/commands/cam-plan.md and templates/commands/cam-plan.md reduced from 254 lines to 29 lines each (thin phase-signal stub: documents how to resolve issue + write phase:planning + narrate; no control-flow). (2) src/vendor/_generated.ts regenerated via bun run embed-vendor. (3) docs/adr/0006-phase-enum-loop-state-machine.md created, documenting the LoopPhase state machine (phase as single source of truth, active derives from phase, phase:planning->runPlanPhase, APPROVE+auto->phase:implementing, BLOCK escalation pattern, B-2/CAM-153 re-plan as forward reference). (4) test/embedded.test.ts: removed the stale 'commands/cam-plan.md contains engineering merit' assertion (the clause lived in Step 6 which was intentionally removed). All 2592 tests pass. bun run check:all exits 0. The PRD is now COMPLETE (all 5 stories pass). The sidecar should detect PRD_COMPLETE and trigger the review cycle.
